## Clause ② — declared **yes**, ⛔ the stricter reading

The mechanical floor names a new exported symbol or a new key on a published payload; an added **optional parameter** on a published callback type is strictly neither. But the 甲 ruling on card objectui#9736 (`5732099575`) treats 「the TypeScript accept set widens」 as `Clause-②: yes`, and this is the same shape — a published declaration catching up to a call the runtime already makes.

⇒ 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动」: declared **yes**, and the isolated **at-tier** contract review route is owed before landing. ⚠️ The dev still tests it against its own diff and reports what it measures; if that reading differs, this seat re-judges on the measurement, ⛔ not on this declaration.
